notes:
ACCESS: https://www.nordstrom.com/robots.txt fetched first via probe.fetch (HTTP 200, profile rotation). It names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User agent - only AdsBot-Google, Googlebot-Image, Googlebot and '*'. The '*' block disallows /sr?*, /search?*, /sr/, /api/* (with Allow exceptions for /api/ng-looks/ and /api/recs/), /brands/*filterByBrand*, /browse/*/libs/*, PDP variants under /s/*, /checkout*, /my-account*, /m/*, /o/*, /wcm/*, /shared/*, /src/*, /similar/*, /styleboard*, /curation*, /stylists/connect* and account paths; declared sitemap https://www.nordstrom.com/sitemap. I requested none of those - no /sr, no /search, no /api call, no /brands filter URL and no PDP. All XML sitemaps I read are outside every Disallow.

TRANSPORT: as in the prior Home-Decor and Furniture passes on this SR, Nordstrom's HTML content routes serve the Akamai/ISTL JavaScript interstitial to non-browser clients - probe.fetch returns HTTP 200 but the body is the 255KB 'window[\'istlWasHere\'] = true' bootstrap with an empty <title> and no product markup, and r.jina.ai returns the same interstitial. The sitemaps are NOT protected and come back as genuine XML through probe.fetch. So: TREE from the sitemaps via probe.fetch, and every COUNT from WebFetch, which renders past the interstitial and reads the site's own '<N> items' header.

TREE: https://www.nordstrom.com/navigation-sitemap.xml (HTTP 200, 317,325 bytes) is the complete published nav tree - 2,491 URLs sitewide, 72 of them under /browse/home. The Home department's tier-2 nodes are Bath, Bedding, Decor, Dining & Entertainment, Dorm Room Essentials, Electronics, Fall Harvest, Halloween Decor, Housewarming Gifts, Kitchenware, Luggage & Travel, New, Outdoor, Pantry, Pet Accessories, Travel Essentials and Water Bottles & Tumblers. /browse/home/bath is the Bathroom entry point and it has EXACTLY TWO children in the sitemap - /browse/home/bath/bathroom-accessories and /browse/home/bath/towels - which is confirmed independently by the rendered left-nav on all three pages (All Bath, Bath Accessories, Towels, plus two cross-department links to /browse/beauty/bath-body and /browse/women/clothing/sleepwear-robes/robes, which are Beauty and Apparel nodes, not Home). Because valid children exist, the parent /browse/home/bath is a GROUPING row with blank qty and blank link per rules 24 and 38.

DEPTH PROOF (no third level): I scanned every navigation-filter-sitemap-*.xml. Files 1-22 exist (10,000 URLs each except file 22 with 9,881 = 219,881 URLs total); files 23, 24 and 25 return HTTP 403 and do not exist. Across all 219,881 filter URLs the ONLY ones touching the bath tree are 391 entries, and every one is either ?filterByBrand=<brand> (e.g. onsen, matouk, yamazaki, simplehuman, zadro, parachute, ralph-lauren, sferra, uchino, ugg, boll-branch, acca-kappa, pigeon-and-poodle) or ?filterByColor=<color>. Nordstrom publishes NO product-type sub-facet for bath, so Bathroom Accessories is a genuine terminal leaf. Cross-checked against https://www.nordstrom.com/top-5k-browse-sitemap.xml (HTTP 200, 5,005 URLs): its only bath entries are /browse/home/bath/towels and three of its filterByBrand variants - no additional bath node anywhere.

QTY SOURCE + VERIFICATION: the site's own rendered '<N> items' header, read through WebFetch. Home > Bath = '1444 items'; Bathroom Accessories = '771 items'; Towels = '673 items'. STRONGEST CHECK: 771 + 673 = 1444 EXACTLY - the two children partition the parent with zero residue, which independently confirms both child counts and confirms that Bath has no hidden third child. Counts discriminate per node (1444 / 771 / 673 / 101 / 852 / 81), so they are not a site-wide constant, and every page's H1 matched the node requested ('Bath', 'Bathroom Accessories', 'Bath Towels'). PAGINATION CHECK on the recorded leaf: the pagination control tops out at page 11, and Nordstrom's page size is 72, so ceil(771/72) = 11 - consistent. DRIFT, DISCLOSED: the header on this leaf was read four times - ?page=1 -> '771 items', canonical -> '771 items', ?page=3 -> '771 items', ?page=8 -> '803 items'. Three of four reads agree on 771 and it is the figure the canonical page and page 1 render, so 771 is recorded; the single 803 reading is intra-session inventory drift on a marketplace-style assortment and is flagged here rather than averaged or aggregated.

EXCLUDED, WITH REASON: /browse/home/bath itself - parent with valid children, rule 24 (kept only as the grouping row). /browse/sale/home/bath - a SALE listing, rule 25. /browse/beauty/bath-body and its 8 children (body moisturizers, body scrubs, body wash & shower gel, bubble bath & oil, deodorant, hand & foot care, hand sanitizer & soap, oral care) plus the beauty-department bath-body re-cuts - these are cosmetics/personal-care consumables, primary product type is a body product, not bathroom equipment; the Bath left-nav merely cross-links to them. /browse/women|men/clothing/sleepwear-robes/robes - apparel robes, rule 20 sends bathrobes to Textile and they sit in Apparel, not Home. /browse/home/decor/storage-organization ('852 items') - general home storage under the Decor department (jewelry boxes, laundry hampers and drying racks, over-door racks, decorative boxes, kitchen/fridge organizers, desk trays); rules 30-33 keep general storage in Storage even though a few Yamazaki items (Rolling Bathroom Organizer) are bathroom-shaped, and the node carries no bathroom framing. /browse/home/decor/lighting ('Lighting & Lamps') - checked explicitly per rule 19: it is a single general lamp node with no bathroom, vanity, mirror-light or IP-rated sub-node, so NOTHING was routed to Lighting for this company. /browse/home/decor/furniture ('Accent Furniture') - the only Home furniture node, no bathroom vanity or bathroom cabinet sub-node. FIXTURES: Nordstrom sells no toilets, basins, baths, shower enclosures, taps/faucets or vanity units - a grep of all 2,491 navigation-sitemap URLs for toilet|sink|basin|faucet|vanit|shower(enclosure) returns nothing in the Home department, and the only 'shower' hits sitewide are /browse/kids/baby/shower-gifts (baby-shower gifting) and /browse/beauty/bath-body/body-wash-shower-gel.

review.issue: ROUTED TO TEXTILE: the second and only other child of Home > Bath. Its own H1 renders as 'Bath Towels' and the grid is bath towels, bath sheets, hand towels, face towels and towel sets (Nordstrom Organic Hydrocotton 6-Piece Towel Set, Matouk Milagro Bath Towel / Bath Sheet, Supreme Hygro Supima 8 Piece Towel Set, Renaissance Classic Egyptian Cotton 8 Piece Towel Set, Hydrocotton Stripe Set of 2 Bath Towels, Set of Two Organic Hydrocotton Hand Towels ...). Rules 15 and 20 send bath/hand/face towels and bath sheets to Textile. Site's own rendered header: '673 items'.

review.sub_category: Bathroom Accessories (textile portion of the same node)
review.issue: ROUTED TO TEXTILE - PARTIAL OVERLAP, NO SEPARATE URL EXISTS. A large minority of the 771 products on the Bathroom Accessories node are bath textiles that rules 15/16/20 assign to Textile: bath mats and bath rugs (Nordstrom Organic Hydrocotton Bath Mat, Renaissance Classic Cushiony Soft Cotton Bath Mat, Luxe Looped Cotton 2-Piece Bath Mat Set, Portobello Stripe Coastal Bath Rugs, Lands' End Cotton Non-skid Contour Bath Rug, Scallop Detail Cotton Bath Mat, Speckle Bath Mat, Deep Pile Non-Slip Bath Rug, Supreme 1000GSM Cotton Bath Mat, Brixton Textured Soft Cotton Bath Mat, Waffle Weave Organic Cotton Bath Mat, Organic Cotton Shag Bath Rug, Trellis Textured Bath Mat, Essence Solid Bath Mat, Ginny Bath Mat, MacKenzie-Childs Sterling Check 2-Piece Bath Set) and shower curtains (Chenille Rose Shower Curtain, Panama Stripe Shower Curtain, Wyeth Trail Shower Curtain, Block Print Gauze Shower Curtain, Classic Chain Scallop Shower Curtain). Nordstrom publishes NO product-type sub-node and NO product-type filter that isolates them - I scanned all 22 reachable navigation-filter-sitemap-*.xml files (~219,881 URLs; files 23-25 return 403 and do not exist) and the ONLY filter URLs under /browse/home/bath or /browse/home/bath/bathroom-accessories are ?filterByBrand=<brand> and ?filterByColor=<color>. So they cannot be given their own row without inventing a URL (rule 27). The row above therefore carries the site's own full node count of 771 and this entry flags the overlap so the Textile pass sees it. qty deliberately left null - counting the textile share would be an estimate, which rule 26 forbids. The genuinely-Bathroom products that make the node a valid Bathroom row are numerous and unambiguous: Yamazaki Tower Slim Rolling Bathroom Cabinet, Yamazaki Rin Toilet Organizer, Yamazaki Bathroom Organizer, HAPPIMESS Tilly 3-Tier Freestanding Bathroom Shower Caddy, Maris Coastal Acacia Corner Shower Stool, Orla Acacia Shower Bench, Expandable Wood Bath Tray, Luxe Stone Marble Bathroom Countertop Tray, Filtered Handheld Showerhead, Red Light Shower Filter, Le Marais Tumbler, William Glass for toothbrushes, Hielo Brush Holder, Toothbrush Holder and Liquid Soap Dispenser 2 Pcs Set, Capiz Blanc / Woven Gold Soap Dish, Woven Platinum / Domus Matte Pump Dispenser, 9 oz rechargeable liquid sensor pump, Rechargeable Sensor Pump Foam Soap Dispenser, Galuchat / Greek Key / Capiz Champagne / Contempo Hammered Waste Basket, Nuvola Cloud / Sofia / Claudia / Contempo Hammered Tissue Cover, Artifacts Trading Storage Canister, Domus and Lydia trays, Double X-Frame Hamper.

ROUTED TO TEXTILE + SEASONAL CURATED SHOP, NOT RECORDED AS A ROW. This node exists in navigation-sitemap.xml, but it is a back-to-college curated shop, not a taxonomy branch: its breadcrumb is Home > Dorm Room Essentials > Towels & Bath, its H1 renders as 'Towels for Dorms & College Apartments', and its siblings are Bedding / Cooking & Kitchen / Decor, Storage & Desk Accessories - i.e. a room-themed seasonal edit, which rule 25 bars. Its 81 products are re-cuts of the Home > Bath assortment and are overwhelmingly bath textiles (Nordstrom Organic Hydrocotton 6-Piece Towel Set, Organic Hydrocotton Bath Mat, Set of 4 Bath Towels, 3-Pack Hero Face Towels, Resort Stripe Organic Cotton Towels, Coyuchi Cloud Loom Bath Essentials, Scallop Detail Cotton Bath Mat, Soft Rib Bath Mat, Air Weight Organic Cotton Bath Towel, Mediterranean / Temescal Organic Cotton Bath Essentials, Scallop 4-Piece Towel Set) with a single non-textile item, the Yamazaki Tower Slim Rolling Bathroom Cabinet, which is already inside the Bathroom Accessories row above. Recording it would both breach rule 25 and duplicate an assortment already counted (rule 28). Site's own rendered header: '81 items'.

LOW CONFIDENCE, NOT RECORDED (rule 29) - logged so the rule-10 mirror inspection is auditable. Nordstrom's only mirror node sits at Home > Home Decor > Mirrors, between Lighting & Lamps and Picture Frames, i.e. a wall-decor hierarchy with no bathroom, vanity-unit, LED-bathroom, demister or medicine-cabinet framing and no bathroom breadcrumb. The overwhelming majority of its 101 products are decorative wall, table and floor mirrors (Sculpt Mirror, Taio Floor Mirror, MacKenzie-Childs Courtly Check Small/Large Wall Mirror, Wavy Mirror with Scalloped Frame, Vintage Art Deco Wall Mirror, Sol Mirror, Sculptural Bobbin Frame Wall Mirror, Beaded Hanging Mirror, Ume Table Mirror, Phiale Mirror, Gervais Full Length Mirror, Organic Wall Mirror, Art Deco Shaped Mirror, Woven Chain-Link Frame Mirror, Arched Dowel Frame Wall Mirror), so by PRIMARY TYPE + FUNCTION + HIERARCHY the node is Decor and duplicating it into Bathroom would breach rule 19's no-duplication principle and rules 30-33. It does however contain a small number of simplehuman-style sensor/vanity mirrors (e.g. 'Hard Wired Wall Mount Sensor Mirror', 'Versatile Vogue Metal Dressing Mirror') which rule 10 would treat as Bathroom on primary type. There is no sub-node and no product-type filter that isolates them (the only published filters on this node are ?filterByColor=<color>), so they cannot be recorded without inventing a URL. Flagged rather than guessed.
